description: Create an address for an agent to use. Say where with `domain_id`, `domain` ("yourdomain.com") or a whole `address` — every address you already have carries its `domain_id`. **`inbox` decides what it is**: with one, mail is stored and a person can open it; without one it becomes an event and your webhook fires. `send_policy: "reply_only"` makes it unable to write to anybody who has not written to it first, which is the right default for an agent. `expires_at` gives it an end date, after which it stops accepting mail. **`pod_id` puts it in one of your customers’ pods**, which is what keeps their sending reputation theirs — `list_pods` has the ids, and your account’s default pod is used when you name none.
name: create_address
title: Create an address
